summary: Amkor Technology filed an 8-K regarding the issuance of $1.15 billion aggregate principal amount of 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, including $150 million from full exercise of the initial purchasers' over-allotment option. The notes are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by certain subsidiaries. They bear no regular interest, mature on July 15, 2031, and are convertible prior to April 15, 2031. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; the filing merely reports entry into a material definitive agreement for capital raising.
